name: Ollama
description: Chat with locally installed Ollama models and manage Ollama updates

tools.name: select_model
tools.description: Switch the active Ollama model. Presents a picker of all installed models.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a message to the active Ollama model and stream the response back to iPhone.

tools.name: refresh
tools.description: Re-scan installed Ollama models and update the model picker.

tools.name: clear_history
tools.description: Clear the current chat session history.
